heading: # ZK60 decisions register — the rulings that govern the proof project
lead: **Read this before claiming any security or privacy property, and record every new ruling here the day it is made.** One entry per decision: what was decided, by whom, why, what it means day to day, and what would reopen it.
tail: Entries are never deleted; a reversed decision gets a new entry that points back. Keep this file short enough to read in five minutes.
